newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines to cut import duties on 24 products.
newsitem.headline: Philippines to cut import duties on 24 products.

text.p: The Philippines will cut import duties on 24 products in the next few days, the presidential palace said on Monday.

They will include duty cuts on 22 items for countries with Most Favoured Nation (MFN) status. Tariffs on two other items will be cut to bring them on par with ASEAN's Common Effective Preferential Tariff (CEPT), the palace said .
The Philippines is a member of the Association of South East Asian Nations (ASEAN), whose other members are Brunei, Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Vietnam.

Among the products to be included in the preferential MFN rates are corn, food flavouring materials, gypsum, cement, zinc peroxide, paper, semi-finished products of iron or non-alloy steel, and copper wires.
Zinc oxide and polycarboxylic acids are the two products on which rates would be aligned with the ASEAN CEPT.
